title: sorbus intermedia
intro: Sorbus intermedia, commonly known as the Lapland whitebeam, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous tree with a broad, rounded crown and white flowers that bloom in the spring. The health benefits of Sorbus intermedia include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, and its therapeutic actions include antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects that help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus intermedia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
